blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said that they are prepared for the verdict of the Senate impeachment court on her impeachment trial but cited the possible consequences should she be convicted of the allegations against her. While there is no definite date on when the trial will end, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro, a member of the House prosecution panel, earlier expressed hope for the trial to end on December 18, Friday. The said date is the last session of Congress before it adjourns for the holidays. READ: Luistro hoping Sara Duterte impeachment trial ends on Dec. 18 […]...
